```{r}
concept_doi <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter("IPBES_Data_Vision.qmd")$zenodo$concept_doi
```

## Releases

Citable versions with a DOI, read live from Zenodo. Concept DOI (always the latest version): [`r concept_doi`](https://doi.org/`r concept_doi`)

```{r, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf('<div id="release-list" data-concept-doi="%s"><p>Loading releases from Zenodo&hellip;</p></div>', concept_doi))
```

## Pre-releases

Drafts for review, archived on GitHub. **Pre-releases have no DOI and are not for citation.**

<div id="prerelease-list" data-repo="IPBES-Data/IPBES_Data_Vision"><p>Loading pre-releases from GitHub&hellip;</p></div>

```{=html}
<style>
#release-list table, #prerelease-list table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 0.75rem; }
#release-list th, #prerelease-list th { text-align: left; padding: 0.55rem 1rem 0.55rem 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #d7dee6; }
#release-list td, #prerelease-list td { padding: 0.6rem 1rem 0.6rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7ebef; white-space: nowrap; }
</style>
<script>
(() => {
  const link = (href, text) => `<a href="${href}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${text}</a>`;

  // Fill box with a table built from fetch(url) → rows; on failure show fallback(message).
  const fill = async (box, url, toRows, header, fallback) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      const rows = toRows(await response.json());
      if (!rows.length) throw new Error("none published yet");
      box.innerHTML = `<table><thead><tr>${header.map((h) => `<th>${h}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead>` +
        `<tbody>${rows.map((r) => `<tr>${r.map((c) => `<td>${c}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>`;
    } catch (error) {
      box.innerHTML = fallback(error.message);
    }
  };

  const releases = document.getElementById("release-list");
  const conceptDoi = releases.dataset.conceptDoi;
  // ponytail: one page of 25 (Zenodo's anonymous maximum); add paging past 25 versions.
  fill(releases,
    `https://zenodo.org/api/records?q=conceptrecid:${conceptDoi.match(/(\d+)$/)[1]}&all_versions=true&sort=mostrecent&size=25`,
    (json) => json.hits.hits.map((r) => {
      const pdf = (r.files || []).find((f) => /\.pdf$/i.test(f.key));
      return [r.metadata.version || "-", r.metadata.publication_date, link(`https://doi.org/${r.doi}`, r.doi),
              pdf ? link(pdf.links.self, "PDF") : "-", link(r.links.self_html, "Record")];
    }),
    ["Version", "Release date", "DOI", "Download", "Zenodo"],
    (msg) => `<p>Could not load releases (${msg}). See all versions on Zenodo: ` +
      `${link(`https://doi.org/${conceptDoi}`, conceptDoi)}</p>`);

  const pre = document.getElementById("prerelease-list");
  const repo = pre.dataset.repo;
  fill(pre,
    `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases?per_page=100`,
    (list) => list.filter((r) => r.prerelease && !r.draft && !/-test\./.test(r.tag_name)).map((r) => {
      const pdf = r.assets.find((a) => /\.pdf$/i.test(a.name));
      return [r.tag_name.replace(/^v/, ""), (r.published_at || "").slice(0, 10),
              pdf ? link(pdf.browser_download_url, "PDF") : "-", link(r.html_url, "GitHub")];
    }),
    ["Version", "Date", "Download", "Release notes"],
    (msg) => `<p>No pre-releases listed (${msg}). See ${link(`https://github.com/${repo}/releases`, "GitHub releases")}.</p>`);
})();
</script>
```
